title: Let Us Sing to the Lord

questions.question: Oh come, let us sing to the Lord; let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:1 (ESV): "...let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation!"

questions.question: Let us come into his presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to him with songs of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:2 (ESV): "...let us make a joyful noise to him with songs of praise!"

questions.question: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:3 (ESV): "For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods."

questions.question: In his hand are the depths of the earth; the heights of the mountains are his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:4 (ESV): "...the heights of the mountains are his also."

questions.question: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:5 (ESV): "...and his hands formed the dry land."

questions.question: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the Lord, our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:6 (ESV): "Oh come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the Lord, our Maker!"

questions.question: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:7 (ESV): "...and the sheep of his hand."

questions.question: Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts, as at where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:8 (ESV): "...do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah,"

questions.question: As on the day at Massah in the wilderness, when your fathers put me to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:9 (ESV): "...when your fathers put me to the test..."

questions.question: For forty years I loathed that generation and said, "They are a people who go astray in their what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:10 (ESV): "...They are a people who go astray in their heart,"

questions.question: Therefore I swore in my wrath, "They shall not enter my what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:11 (ESV): "Therefore I swore in my wrath, 'They shall not enter my rest.'"

questions.question: What have they not known, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:10 (ESV): "...and they have not known my ways."

questions.question: What did they see in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Psalm 95:9 (ESV): "...and put me to the proof, though they had seen my work."

questions.question: Who is the "we" in "we are the people of his pasture"?
This Psalm is often used as a call to what?
questions.explanation: The content (Venite) is a classic call to worship.

key_verse_text: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the Lord, our Maker! For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand.
